citations.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 天津古籍出版社 / 遼寧人民出版社, 2012
citations.field: 山部 entry; printed p. 810, PDF p. 823; continuation checked on printed p. 811, PDF p. 824
citations.text: The entry identifies 山 as a pictograph of mountain peaks standing together. It describes Shang oracle-bone forms as showing mountain outlines, and Shang and Western Zhou bronze forms as varying between filled or outlined forms and three or five peaks. It describes subsequent stylization, gives the basic sense as a high, pointed part of the ground, and cites 《合集》96 and examples from the 詩經 and 荀子. The printed prose and cited forms checked match the provisional OCR; the entry ends on p. 810, with no continuation on p. 811.
